title: Theme
description: Theme definition providing default styles, page settings, and named block style presets.

key.description: Key of the theme resource: the same rule as every resource key. Until contract 2.0 this member was called id.

documentStyles.description: Default document-level styles inherited by all templates using this theme.

pageSettings.description: Default page settings inherited by templates using this theme.

blockStylePresets.description: Named block style presets (like CSS classes). Key is the preset name.

spacingUnit.description: Base spacing unit in points for the spacing scale. All sp values (e.g. 2sp, 4sp) are multiples of this value. Absent means default (4pt).

DefaultBlockStyles.description: The theme's baseline block spacing (#59): the margin a flow block (text, rich text variable, container, columns, table, datatable, QR code, image) gets when nothing more specific sets one. Only margin keys take effect (margin, marginTop, marginRight, marginBottom, marginLeft); others are reported. Below the document styles, a block style preset and a node's own styles in the cascade, above a component's structural defaults; never inherited. Absent, the renderer supplies its own fallback, which the contract does not fix. One baseline for every listed block; a per-type map may be added later.

styles.description: CSS-like style properties for this preset.

applicableTo.description: Node types this preset can be applied to. Empty or absent means all types.
